methodology.title: Calculation Methodology & Formula
methodology.subtitle: Transparent, verifiable mathematical model for agricultural produce net realization.
methodology.formulaStep1: 1. Realized Price = Modal Auction Price × (1 - Quality Cut %)
methodology.formulaStep2: 2. Statutory Fees = Realized Price × (Market Fee % + Commission %)
methodology.formulaStep3: 3. Transport Cost = ⌈Quantity / Vehicle Capacity⌉ × Rate/km × Distance
methodology.formulaStep4: 4. Net Realization = Realized Price - Statutory Fees - Transport Cost - Handling

footer.disclaimer: Prices shown are indicative modal auction rates from data.gov.in.
